evidence.mission_note: As a future keeper this is a desirable spec. It is the bore-exposed 3.4 S, which the profile allows only with unusually strong engine diligence. At expected market price it sits well above the ideal $10k-$19k band, so it conflicts with cash preservation in accelerated_bridge mode.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity well: VIN and build sheet confirm a 2006 Cayman S six-speed with Sport Chrono Plus, PASM and adaptive sport seats. It also claims 40,325 miles matching the Carfax, a clean Ohio title and no reported accidents. Photos support a clean, stock, cosmetically sound car. Maintenance evidence is thin: pre-sale oil, brake fluid and engine mounts are dealer claims without invoices, and the 22 Carfax service entries are not shown. The seller says he does not know whether the clutch is original. The decisive M97 questions — cylinder walls, over-rev history, cooling and AOS service — remain open. The dealer has promised a borescope and oil-filter photos, which have not yet been posted. The current $10,000 bid is far below a fair value of roughly $29.5k-$35.8k and will not reflect the final price on a reserve auction.
evidence.next_action: Before Wednesday's close, contact 2FAM to schedule an independent South Florida Porsche specialist PPI with borescope and DME over-rev report, and request the full Carfax plus the service invoices.
